# Wickra ZK

> Zero-knowledge, on-chain-verifiable backtest performance — without revealing your data or your strategy.

Wickra ZK runs a deterministic Wickra backtest inside a zero-knowledge circuit and produces a proof that a stated result was reached, without publishing the strategy specification or the underlying data. Verification is cheap enough to run where the claim matters. Released under the MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.

## Source
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wickra-lib/wickra-zk): Source, issues, and releases.

## Ecosystem
- [Wickra](https://wickra.org): The core streaming-indicator library the ecosystem is built on.
- [Docs](https://docs.wickra.org): Documentation for the Wickra core.
